checkin: We look forward to seeing you! What to Bring Sunglasses, hat, sunscreen (no spray sunscreen – it stains our boat seats), and any food and beverages that you would like. During the off-season, we always recommend bringing at the very least a warm sweatshirt. In the winter months, we recommend jackets–It can get chilly out there.
cancellation: WEATHER Your captain will make the call on weather and cancelling/rescheduling your tour up to an hour prior to your tour. If we cannot reschedule you, we will provide a full refund of any fare that you have paid. Guests that have not purchased trip insurance will have up to 72 hours to cancel their reservation for no fee (minus the trip insurance amount). Before 72 hours from charter departure time = 50% refund Before 48 hours from charter departure time = $25% refund Anything inside of 48 hours of charter departure date and time will be charged full amount of the charter.
policies: WEATHER Your captain will make the call on weather and cancelling/rescheduling your tour up to an hour prior to your tour.
Should the weather not allow us to go out, we will make every effort that we can to reschedule you.
If we cannot reschedule you, we will provide a full refund of any fare that you have paid.
Guests that have not purchased trip insurance will have up to 72 hours to cancel their reservation for no fee (minus the trip insurance amount).
Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 48 hours notice of cancellation.
Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.
